channel.title: Enterprise AI News Studio
channel.itunes:title: Enterprise AI News Studio
channel.description: General enterprise-relevant AI news for Tim Hoyt. Episodes cover model launches, product changes, and clearly labeled leaks and rumors from labs including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, and Meta.
channel.itunes:author: Tim Hoyt

item.title: Episode 3: The xAI Edition
item.description: Episode 3 is all about xAI, now SpaceX Super Intelligence. Grok Voice 3.0 tops a speech leaderboard, Cursor joins The X Subscription and can now control your computer, Grok Build gains memory, and Grok Bot learns to build live dashboards and passes 800,000 paid weekly users. Then, clearly labeled as ideas, we share ways to use Grok Bot, including a briefing built from the AI voices you follow on X.
item.itunes:title: Episode 3: The xAI Edition
item.itunes:author: Tim Hoyt

item.title: Episode 2: OpenAI Goes Enterprise
item.description: Episode 2: OpenAI Goes Enterprise. OpenAI's models and Codex are coming to Google Cloud, where companies can pay from their existing cloud commitments. Its new Decisions API charges ten cents per million input tokens and nothing for output, and Uber is putting ChatGPT Work in front of more than 30,000 employees. We also trace the unconfirmed GPT-6.1 Terra rumor from a Microsoft code change, and look at what this week means for enterprise AI buyers.
item.itunes:title: Episode 2: OpenAI Goes Enterprise
item.itunes:author: Tim Hoyt

item.title: Episode 1: Claude News Edition
item.description: Andrew and Ava cover confirmed Claude news through October 23, 2026: Fable 5 and its return, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5, plus the Claude Duet research preview, the Claude Security public beta, and Claude Platform on Google Cloud. Unconfirmed Fable 5.5 rumors stay labeled as rumors, including a Tuesday, October 27 date to watch.
item.itunes:title: Episode 1: Claude News Edition
item.itunes:author: Tim Hoyt
